game_title: Return Or Print – Skating Pond Trial
game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Snowy Hold – Skating Pond, a frozen skating pond: the firewood keeper must handle frost imps while practicing functions. Core idea – Return Or Print: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on.
theme: Snowy Hold – Skating Pond: a frozen skating pond
core_gameplay_loop: In Skating Pond, repeat each round: Decide whether to return or print and see why only return passes data on. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the court_score value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the chapel bell using at most 17 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The chapel bell reached with actions_used <= 17.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 17 before the chapel bell is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 6 – Functions | Level 6 (applied tier): Return Or Print
assets_style: cozy pixel-art snow town: icy blue rooftops, frosted pines, warm lantern glow; flat Kenney-style sprites; soft bells, wind howls and cozy hearth crackle
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Return Or Print' (Week 6 slot 15), mission type 'Efficiency Trial', and setting 'Skating Pond'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how court_score changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against frost imps in Skating Pond.
